intended_outcome: The public copy's suite runs the tests of the qualification, gate-checker and reference-suite checks that do not need a left-out file, and skips the 50 that do, while the private suite runs all of them.

acceptance_criteria.text: Guards. The 50 tests that read a left-out file (all of test_qualification_check.py, the seven named tests of test_aidf_check.py, the named test of test_reference_suite_v2.py) carry a guard on the existence of the files they read, with a reason that names the file; no other test is guarded.
Private suite unchanged. In the private tree no guarded test is skipped: the suite's skip count is the same as at the base and its test count is the base's plus the tests this change adds.
Pin. A test in the private tree asserts that every guarded file exists and is tracked; a mutation that renames or removes a guarded file is failed by a test.

Published. The manifest no longer excludes the three test files and is otherwise changed only in the notes sentence; the export test's pins and notes pin follow, and a test asserts the three files are published.

The export passes. python verification/export_public_tree.py --out <empty directory outside the repository> --run-tests reports compile, exported suite, scan and byte identity as PASS; the exported suite's test and skip counts are recorded in the dispositions and are about 120 tests higher than the base's 388.
No other change. verification/export_public_tree.py is byte-identical to the base; no core, template, preflight or run_review.py change; no left-out file is published.

Outcome records (core/05-review.md section 6): the review report patterns are verification/restore-excluded-tests-verifier-report*.md; the dispositions file is verification/restore-excluded-tests-verifier-dispositions.md. This criterion only declares the outcome-record paths.
